journal.text:
I read through the minbpe code this session: regex.py, base.py, basic.py, gpt4.py, __init__.py and the lineage_bench.py harness. Then I made two edits to minbpe/regex.py. One replaced 20 lines at lines 103-122 with 6. The other changed a single line at line 17.

I never ran a sandbox evaluation on either edit, so I have no measured result. The session ended without a candidate and nothing was submitted. Whether those regex.py changes are correct or faster is unknown.

From reading, the tokenizer logic sits mostly in regex.py and base.py, and gpt4.py builds on the regex tokenizer. Shrinking the block at lines 103-122 looked possible to me, but that is untested belief and nothing more. I also don't know how lineage_bench.py would weigh a change like this.

Next time I should start from those two edits, or redo them, and run the bench in the sandbox right away before changing anything else. I should check that encode and decode output still match the original. Then I should submit only if the bench shows a real difference.
